functions.notes: Neighbour file: pool class with 0x1C-byte elements.

MakeNew with the constructor inlined (size 0x50). The ctor store sequence (list vptr 0x1C, vptr 0x2C x3, 0x18 x2, 0 x1, flag byte 0x30, 0x4C=0) is reproduced with a B1/B2 second base and __forceinline on the ctor, but register allocation/scheduling differs (uses r31; the target uses only r3-r11). The harness cannot pair or diff the final version; 36% is from an earlier variant. Without __forceinline the ctor is not inlined.
RetClassName. Identical shape (lis/addi/blr); the harness pairs F12 (other file, same shape) with it, so F08 itself shows 50% against an unrelated function.
Neighbour file: loads a global pointer. Harness shows a false EXACT against our RetGangManager stub.
Neighbour file: returns address of a global. Same shape as RetClassName, so a false EXACT.
Scalar deleting destructor (compiler generated), vtable slot 0. Harness pairs it with cConfigBase's identical deleting dtor; cFactionConfigData's own is generated identically.
Destructor body: stores vptrs 0, 0x18, 0x2C, calls cConfigBase dtor (0x8276F0C0) then CAttributeHandler dtor. Needs a user-declared empty ~cFactionConfigData and the second and third vptr subobjects.
HandleAttributes, 776 bytes, exact. Switch case order 1,2,3,4,5,0,6; local-float RwMemNative32 byte swap; faction mapping switch; inlined SetupFaction (unsigned conversion, member-address null test).
Constructor of another class (0x210+ bytes, small string at 0x64) that shares the second base.

header_notes: Work header (cFactionConfigData/work/cFactionConfigData.h) defines invented stubs: cConfigList, cConfigB1, cConfigB2, cConfigBase (CD2's 0x1C-byte polymorphic second base at 0x18: vptr+list head, vptr+bool; RuffKing's DynamicAllocationPolicy base does not match), AI::cFactionTargetingProfile (needs a cConfigBase member/base at +0x18), eFactions (0 civilians, 1 freaks, 2 agency, 3 cell; the attribute maps 0->0, 1->3, 2->2, 3->1). Repo header changes recommended: (1) CAttributeCommand::GetAs_float (or GetAs_Real) inline as *(const float*)&chunk_.data_ (I defined it inline in the cpp); (2) a free function FindEntityInMap(const RWSGUID&) (the repo's cGUIDLinkerBase::FindEntityInMap is a protected member; CD2 calls a free function with a pointer to a stack copy); (3) a cGangManager stub with inline RetGangManager reading global 0x83800D84 and a faction pointer array at +0x30, faction struct fields at 0x1C, 0x98, 0xA4 (unsigned int[6]). Class size 0x50: floats at 0x34, faction at 0x48, profile link at 0x4C.
split_notes: Belong: F07 (MakeNew with inlined ctor), F08 (RetClassName), F13 (scalar deleting dtor, vtable slot 0), F14 (dtor body), F15 (HandleAttributes, vtable slot 1), F18, F19. Do not belong: F01-F06 (one pool class), F09-F12 (global accessors, a type check, a string accessor), F16/F17 (another class's ctor/dtor; it shares the second base, which is how the base was identified). Unlike RuffKing, CD2 has no separate out-of-line ctor (inlined into MakeNew). Vtable slots 2-10 and 12 are shared stubs, not part of this file.
